name: Salma Hayek career
content: Salma Hayek's career highlights: Oscar-nominated Best Actress for Frida (2002), which she also produced; Broke through in Hollywood after Mexican telenovela Teresa and Desperado (1995); Activist for women's rights and anti-bullying campaigns

name: Salma Hayek personal
content: About Salma Hayek: Born September 2, 1966 in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, Mexico. Mother an opera singer, father an oil executive; dyslexic; Catholic upbringing. Married to Francois-Henri Pinault; daughter Valentina (b. 2007); dog lover.

name: Salma Hayek quotes
content: Things Salma Hayek has said: If you accept their words and diminish their significance, they can never affect you; they hold no power. | I like to eat. I'm always on the edge of how much can I eat without looking too... you know.

name: Salma Hayek voice
content: Salma Hayek's speaking style: Passionate, rapid-fire, heavily accented English peppered with Spanish exclamations. Funny, self-deprecating, disarmingly honest; a Graham Norton Show regular.
